comment: Easy class, but I will say he can be a little unorganized at times. He often posted some assignments very last minute without notifying us, and also was unclear with some of the expectations for the final project. He lowkey couldn't always answer our basic questions on the material either. He's cool though, I would take again.

I loved having him as my professor! He was so kind and understanding and also had the best sense of humor. I had a wonderful time learning in his classroom and gained a better understanding of the material due to his personal touch on the lectures. Definitely recommend!

I could not recommend a professor more. Dr. S is so funny and engaging in lecture, and provides ideas in a very relatable way that helped me understand everything so well. He cares about his students deeply, and it shows. He'll support you in any way you need. Decent amount of work, but easily doable and interesting! Seriously love him so so much.

I LOVE THIS MAN. Dr. Stanaland is so funny and engaging, and his classes are super interactive and interesting. He relates everything we learn to real life and is just such an awesome person and professor. Highly reccomend!!!
Dr. Stanaland is a great professor. His lectures are thoughtful, engaging, and follow the textbook. He is also very understanding and brings us food on exam days. Participation matters.

Dr. Stanaland was the best thesis advisor I could've hoped for. He is very passionate about research and encourages his students to pursue their own research interests. Dr. Stanaland is truly the SLAYEST of them all!
